description: Select Git and GitHub actions across repositories and run them in order. Sync is only one of those actions.
viewContainer.title: Multi Repo Sync
welcome.gitDisabled: Git is disabled. Enable the built-in Git extension to control repositories from Multi Repo Sync.
welcome.noRepositories: No Git repositories were discovered in this workspace. Repositories opened by VS Code are listed here.
config.title: Multi Repo Sync
config.runOrder: Order used when running the checked steps on the checked repositories.
config.runOrder.perRepository: Finish every step in one repository, then move to the next repository.
config.runOrder.perOperation: Run one step in every repository, then move to the next step.
config.onError: What to do when a step fails.
config.onError.skipRepository: Skip the remaining steps for that repository.
config.timelineLimit: Maximum number of commits shown in the timeline and the recent commits list.
